title: Installer adds only safe PATH directories to permissions.exec_path
objective: In install.sh, after installing with `--harness codex --rea-mode direct`, add to permissions.exec_path of the user config each directory on PATH that holds npx or docker, recording the real path of each, so that rea serve can find npx. Skip a directory that is inside the install tree or the temporary directory, and skip one that other users can write to, printing a line for each skipped directory; when the directory is writable by its group or by others the line reads exactly "Not adding <dir> to permissions.exec_path: group or other users can write to it." An existing exec_path list must be kept without duplicates.
